profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Development | Certified AI Architect | Cloud Architecture (AWS/Azure) | .NET, Python, React, TypeScript | Founder @mikrotikusers.com
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineering leader focused on building scalable applications, integrating AI into enterprise workflows, and leading high-performing engineering teams.

WHAT I DO
• AI integration: building production systems with Claude (Anthropic API), Amazon Bedrock, and LLM-powered automation
• Full-stack application development using .NET Core, Python, React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies
• Cloud architecture and migration (AWS, Microsoft Azure)
• Data engineering: building data warehouses, ETL pipelines, and business intelligence solutions
• Engineering leadership: building and scaling teams, implementing Agile/Scrum methodologies
• DevOps and CI/CD: establishing best practices for automated build, test, and deployment

RECENT ACHIEVEMENTS
• Designed AI-driven workflows combining LLM reasoning with n8n orchestration, reducing manual processing across client engagements
• Built agent-based AI systems that autonomously execute multi-step tasks across APIs, databases, and development tools
• Led engineering teams of 20+ developers at companies like Heyday and Monster Energy
• Designed enterprise data warehouses using AWS Redshift from scratch.  
• Migrated legacy applications to cloud infrastructure

TECHNICAL EXPERTISE
AI & Automation: Claude API, AI Agent Development, n8n Workflow Orchestration
Languages & Frameworks: C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Java, SQL, PowerShell
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Redshift, EC2, S3, Lambda), Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Agile/Scrum, Terraform
Data & Analytics: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ETL Pipelines, Data Warehousing, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, SSIS/SSRS
Architecture: RESTful APIs, Microservices, Full-Stack Development, System Design, Distributed Systems

BEYOND THE CODE
I'm the founder of mikrotikusers.com, an independent publication I launched in 2022 that has built a thriving community of IT engineers sharing best practices in network design, implementation, and troubleshooting using MikroTik hardware and software.
I'm passionate about continuous learning, staying current with emerging technologies — especially the rapidly evolving AI landscape — and mentoring the next generation of engineers. 

LET'S CONNECT
I'm always interested in connecting with fellow technologists, discussing challenging engineering problems, and exploring opportunities to build innovative solutions. Feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Owner / Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading software development consulting firm serving enterprise and mid-market clients.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

• Architect and develop full-stack enterprise applications using C#, .NET Core, TypeScript, Angular, React, and Python with RESTful API and microservices architecture on Azure and AWS

• Integrate Claude (Anthropic API) into enterprise applications, building AI-powered features for content generation, data processing, and workflow automation

• Design and deploy AI-driven automation pipelines combining LLM reasoning with n8n workflow orchestration, reducing manual processing time across client engagements

• Build agent-based AI systems that autonomously execute multi-step tasks across APIs, databases, and development tools

• Develop prompt engineering standards and validation patterns to ensure deterministic, production-reliable AI output

• Embed AI assistance into the software development lifecycle, accelerating prototyping, documentation generation, code review, and test coverage

• Establish CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for automated build, test, and deployment across concurrent client projects

• Manage infrastructure projects including network design, implementation, and optimization using MikroTik hardware and software solutions

Technologies: Claude API, .NET Core, Python, React, TypeScript, Angular, AWS, Azure, Docker, Microservices, RESTful APIs, n8n, MikroTik

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Mikrotik Users is an independent publication launched in August 2022 by Dassl, Inc. It exists to foster a community of IT engineers who exchange ideas, best practices and support for designing, implementing, deploying and troubleshooting networks built using Mikrotik hardware and software

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description:
Led engineering organization of 20+ developers and managed technology strategy for beauty and wellness e-commerce platform serving multiple retail locations nationwide.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

• Collaborated closely with Head of Product and UX to align technology roadmap with business objectives and product vision

• Architected and implemented enterprise data warehouse using AWS Redshift and ETL pipelines, improving data processing speed by 300% and enabling real-time analytics

• Developed 20+ business intelligence reports using Looker, Solve, and SQL, providing actionable insights to Operations, Finance, Sales, and Marketing teams

• Built automated ETL pipelines using Python and AWS Glue to extract, transform, and load data from Shopify Plus, processing 1M+ daily transactions

• Integrated marketing automation (Klaviyo), customer experience platforms (AskNicely), CRM systems (Boulevard), and SEO tools (Semrush) into unified data ecosystem

• Implemented Agile/Scrum methodologies and established engineering best practices, improving sprint velocity by 45%

• Led full-stack development initiatives using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL for customer-facing applications

Technologies: AWS Redshift, Python, AWS Glue, Looker, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Shopify Plus, ETL, Data Warehousing

positions.title: Manager of Application Development | Senior Application Developer | Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Promoted through three engineering roles at Monster Energy, advancing from individual contributor to managing a cross-functional development team delivering enterprise software for global beverage distribution operations.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

• Led development of 20+ internal enterprise applications across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and desktop platforms serving 500+ users

• Architected full-stack applications using C#, .NET Core, Angular, React, TypeScript, and SQL Server with RESTful Web API architecture

• Migrated legacy on-premises applications to Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, improving scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency

• Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Bamboo, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps for automated build, test, and deployment processes

• Designed and built ETL processes, data pipelines, and business intelligence reports using T-SQL, SSIS/SSRS, and Power BI

• Architected SDLC workflows using Atlassian toolset (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) and established source control best practices

• Administered Azure DevOps and Jira, optimizing project management workflows and release processes across the engineering organization

Technologies: .NET Core, C#, React, Angular, TypeScript, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, CI/CD, Bamboo, Bitbucket, Power BI, SSIS/SSRS, RESTful APIs, Jira, Confluence
positions.insights: Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server and +4 skills
